title: Skorzeny shown a demonstration of the Bell craft
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Skorzeny shown a demonstration of the Bell craft, about 1944 at Skoda Works, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: autot scores Zi, who at that time was the master of psychological warfare and special operations, >> shows up to the SCOD works and supposedly he's given a demonstration of this thing

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, tells of a secret Nazi flying craft known as the Bell. He says that around 1944 Otto Skorzeny, whom he calls Germany's master of psychological warfare and special operations at the time, turned up at the Skoda Works, a big industrial plant, and was supposedly given a demonstration of the craft. If true, it would mean the wartime Nazis had built something unusual enough to show off to one of their top special operations men.
